description: six separate forest objects: a mossy fallen log lying on its side, a wide tree stump with roots, a hollow log, a cluster of red-capped mushrooms, a pile of broken branches, a big twisted tree root. for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art. These are SEPARATE GAME SPRITES, ISOLATED objects only: no scene, no forest, no ground, no floor tiles, no grass bases or platforms under them, no shadows on a floor. Arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges, on a plain flat pure white background that fills the whole picture
